title: Graphic studio
hint: Draw a board — text, shapes, brush, charts — and file it in the media library. It can then be inserted into a built page, or shown anywhere by its URL. Every save keeps the image, the SVG when everything is vector, and the replayable JSON.
noPlans: No saved board yet. Start from a format or a template.
noTemplates: The template catalog is empty. Publish a board as a template from the studio, or drop a JSON in public/canvas/templates.
renamed: Board renamed — check the pages that display it.
confirmDelete: Delete “{name}”, its archived versions and its record? Pages showing it will display a missing image.
